story.title: End-to-end acceptance test using the real codex CLI
story.description: As the project, I want a primary acceptance test in codex.integration.test.ts that uses the real codex CLI to spawn 2 sub-agents and proves the live tree reaches the CLI's delta stream and snapshot RPC. Per packages/happy-cli/agents.md, mocked tests do not count as primary acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/happy-cli/src/codex/codex.integration.test.ts gains a new long-form test, guarded by RUN_CODEX_INTEGRATION === '1', that boots a real codex app-server through the existing test rig and asks the agent to spawn 2 sub-agents (child B nested under child A under root)

The test mounts an in-test bridge: constructs the production AgentTreeState reducer, hands the real CodexAppServerClient.setEventHandler callback through the same dispatch the production runCodex.ts uses, and captures emitted deltas through a fake sendAgentTreeUpdate sink

Captured deltas contain the ordered subsequence pending-spawn-started(A) → node-added(A) → pending-spawn-started(B) → node-added(B) (additional interleaved node-status-changed deltas are tolerated; model nondeterminism is bounded by a per-spawn timeout ≤120s)
seq values are strictly increasing across the captured stream

state.snapshot() returns a topology with nodes containing exactly A and B (root is excluded per AgentRegistry.live_agents() semantics) and edges [{parent: rootThreadId, child: A.threadId}, {parent: A.threadId, child: B.threadId}]

Test invocation on Windows / Git Bash: RUN_CODEX_INTEGRATION=1 npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm --filter happy exec vitest run src/codex/codex.integration.test.ts. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY (or equivalent codex auth) in environment
Prompts are deterministic (e.g., 'spawn one explorer named A and instruct A to spawn one explorer named B')

completedSteps: Added a RUN_CODEX_INTEGRATION-gated real Codex app-server agent-tree test scaffold
Mounted production createAgentTreeState reducer dispatch in the integration test and captured fake sendAgentTreeUpdate deltas
Fixed the Windows integration environment runner to invoke pnpm through its CJS entrypoint for native child_process spawn
remainingSteps: Resolve or revise the nested-agent acceptance requirement because real spawned Codex child agents report that spawn_agent and wait_agent are unavailable
Once nested spawning is possible, rerun the gated real Codex integration and full relevant checks
partialProgress.testStatus: happy-cli typecheck passes; focused RUN_CODEX_INTEGRATION test fails because child A cannot spawn/wait for child B; full codex integration also has a pre-existing ws open timeout in one case

## 2026-05-13 13:30:19 PDT - US-005
- Implemented server-side `agent-tree-update` handling in `sessionUpdateHandler`, validating inbound `{ delta }` with `AgentTreeDeltaSchema`, rejecting non-session-scoped sockets, and trusting `connection.sessionId` instead of any client payload session id.
- Added `EventRouter.emitAgentTreeUpdate(...)` and widened routed socket event typing so the server emits outbound `{ sessionId, delta }` frames to session-scoped and user-scoped subscribers without writing to replay.
- Added focused server coverage for EventRouter fan-out and sessionUpdateHandler authorization/validation, and updated existing typed EventRouter test doubles.
- Verified `pnpm --filter "{packages/happy-server}" typecheck` passes; log is in `.test-output/happy-server.typecheck.log`.
- Verified `pnpm --filter "{packages/happy-server}" test` passes 17/17 test files and 88/88 tests; log is in `.test-output/happy-server.test.log`.
- Verified the codex submodule read-only invariant: `git diff --name-only -- codex/external/repos/codex-patched` and `git diff --submodule=diff -- codex` both returned empty output.
- Committed as `b2826f89 feat: US-005 - Server-side authorization, validation, and fan-out`.
- Files changed: `packages/happy-server/sources/app/api/socket/sessionUpdateHandler.ts`, `packages/happy-server/sources/app/api/socket/sessionUpdateHandler.test.ts`, `packages/happy-server/sources/app/events/eventRouter.ts`, `packages/happy-server/sources/app/events/eventRouter.test.ts`, `packages/happy-server/sources/app/api/routes/v3SessionRoutes.test.ts`, `packages/happy-server/sources/app/api/socket.spec.ts`.
- **Learnings for future iterations:**
  - `agent-tree-update` is deliberately not replayable server state; it is a live routed socket frame whose `sessionId` is added by the server for user-scoped demux.
  - When the `EventRouter` interface gains a method, server tests with typed router doubles must be updated even if the specific test does not call the new method.
